issues.description: Out-of-scope file in SHA range: server/src/validators/column.ts was modified (commit 56dca95, separate from the T5 commit 1951bcd). Determination: STRAY but BENIGN, no action required. It is a one-line type-narrowing fix to T1's validator (wipLimit ?? null -> typeof wipLimit === 'number' ? wipLimit : null), functionally equivalent for valid inputs and an improvement for TS narrowing. T5's declared scope is api.ts + BoardPage.tsx + tests only; per spec-compliance protocol this out-of-scope change is noted as an observation, not a deliverable failure, and the QUALITY BAR maps 'work outside listed files' to a concern, not a STOP.

Success-path window.setTimeout(2000) calls refresh() and setPickerState without cleanup or a mounted-guard; if BoardPage unmounts within the 2s window this can trigger a state update on an unmounted component. Harmless in practice (empty-board transient state) and optional to address.
